items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: They used to call me Little Tubby.

ctx.x: Fred Hall, yeah. Now where he got this Tubby from, he got so fat. Oh yeah, he was fat when I was born. They quit calling him Babin, they called him Tubby, they used to call him Big Tubby, and they used to call me Little Tubby.
Little Tubby, I never heard that.

Oh yeah, they used to call me Little Tubby. So that's what started me to play him. So finally when I, the first band that I, it was a three piece band, a fellow by the name, Arthur Campbell, I'm a piano player, I don't know if you've ever heard of him. I've heard of him, yes. Arthur Campbell and Sidney Bechet.
